metadata.purpose: Collect inner descriptions until outer completion, then pair each inner's kth value with FIFO memory.

conditions: Outer next retains one description; no inner is connected before outer completes.
After collection of n > 0 inputs, each tuple contains one oldest queued value from every occurrence in outer order.
A completed input remains usable until its FIFO is empty; then the result completes without waiting for the other inputs.
Empty outer completes without a tuple. An outer that never completes never activates its collected inner descriptions.

scope.parameters: Tuple-output profile; 0..8 valid Observable occurrences; at most 8 unmatched queued values per input. Constructor bounds maxInners 0..16 and bufferLimit 1..16 are model scope, not RxJS capacities.
scope.callbacks: No projector in the canonical profile. Values and source tokens are opaque references; no user function runs in guards or transitions.
scope.time: No clock, scheduler or timer is introduced. Outer/inner sources supply notification times; equal-time inputs retain explicit arrival order.
scope.reentrancy: Post-setup non-reentrant notifications. Outer and inner subscription setup return without notifying or advancing time; cancellation occurs between reactions.
exclusions: Optional projector return/throw and synchronous outer or inner setup are separately native-characterized, outside this canonical alphabet.
Non-Observable inputs and arbitrary ObservableInput conversions.
Histories exceeding source/FIFO bounds, unsafe counters, arbitrary reentrancy, producer-token mutation and cancellation during a notification.
Throwing observer/producer teardown, arbitrary reentrancy and universal infinite-trace liveness are not modeled.

initialization.sourceSubscription: Construction is inert. First connection acquires outer only; outer completion acquires collected inners in order before releasing outer.

ownership.sharing: No implicit sharing or replay. Each result connection owns collection and FIFO state; repeated descriptions create separate input subscriptions even when they refer to one shared producer.
ownership.reset: Create fresh bookkeeping for each result connection. Payload objects are not cloned.

resources.owner: joined occurrence indexed by generation in outer collection order

dispatch.actionSemantics: Ordered action words are model predictions, not executed effects. Callback invocation IDs correlate outcomes; they are not subscription IDs.
cancellationCheckpoints: Between external reactions. Cancellation during synchronous multi-action delivery is characterized separately, not silently admitted into this profile.

inputs.description: Retain one opaque valid Observable description occurrence.
Activate collected inputs, or complete if none exist.
Append one value to an addressed live input FIFO.
Release one input and retain its queue until exhausted.
Fail the entire join with this exact error.

controls.description: See the typed state and named transitions for Collecting.
See the typed state and named transitions for Joining.
Terminated; no owned subscriptions or retained values.

sources.purpose: Upstream scenario basis; test bodies inspected, not claimed to have been executed as the upstream suite.

actions: acquire outer only
rules.explanation: Descriptions do nothing until a result connection exists.

actions: retain the opaque inner description; do not connect it
rules.nextState: Append one source occurrence in outer arrival order.
rules.explanation: Repeated occurrences of the same producer remain distinct future subscriptions.

actions: complete downstream without an empty tuple
release outer
rules.explanation: Joining zero streams is EMPTY. No inner connection occurs.

rules.guard: at least one collected source occurrence
actions: acquire all inners in collection order
release outer after inner acquisition
rules.nextState: One empty FIFO and live connection for each occurrence; emitted count zero.
rules.explanation: toArray forwards its collected list during completion. The deferred inner connections are established before the outer producer teardown runs.

actions: error downstream with the same payload
release outer without connecting inners
rules.explanation: An outer error does not convert the accumulated descriptions into a join.

actions: release outer silently
rules.explanation: Cancellation is not completion and never activates the collected inners.

rules.guard: live addressed inner, room in bounded scope, another FIFO empty
actions: append value to addressed FIFO; emit nothing
rules.nextState: Increase that occurrence's received count; retain all other queues.
rules.explanation: An unmatched value waits. It is neither overwritten by a newer value nor used as backpressure.

rules.guard: live addressed inner, all FIFOs ready after append, no completed FIFO exhausted
actions: append value
remove the oldest value from every FIFO
emit one fresh tuple in collection order
rules.nextState: Increment emitted count and retain each unconsumed FIFO suffix.
rules.explanation: The arrival supplying the final missing member triggers the tuple; at most one tuple is produced by this atomic arrival.

rules.guard: all FIFOs ready after append; a completed FIFO has its final value
actions: emit the last pairable tuple
release still-live inners in collection order
complete downstream after releases
rules.nextState: Closed complete; no unmatched suffix retained.
rules.explanation: The joinAll mergeMap waits for zip finalization before delivering successful completion; producer releases precede downstream complete.

rules.guard: live addressed inner has queued values
actions: release only the completed inner producer
rules.nextState: Mark slot no longer live, retaining its FIFO suffix.
rules.explanation: Completion does not discard values already available for future tuples.

rules.guard: live addressed inner has no queued values
actions: release all still-live inners in collection order
complete downstream after releases
rules.explanation: No further tuple is possible when a completed input has no value remaining, even if other inners never complete.

actions: error downstream with original payload
release all live inner producers in collection order
rules.nextState: Closed inner-error; discard all FIFO values.
rules.explanation: Error is forwarded before teardown; it does not use the successful-completion finalization path.

actions: release live inners in collection order without notification
rules.explanation: Cancellation does not flush a partial tuple or notify completion.
